title: Sequencer-Enforced Gate Executor V1
claim: FP-MCP-312 implemented a V1 enforced next-gate executor in the MCP bridge. The new executor calls the sequencer internally and supports the clearance preview/create segment without manual follow-on tool selection. Bridge commit 5a75db7 contains the implementation.
summary: The MCP bridge repository feature/oauth-auth0 advanced from 6b6fcc3 to 5a75db7 with commit 'Add guarded canary next-gate executor'. The implementation adds src/guarded-canary-gate-executor.ts and registers forgepilot_apply_guarded_canary_next_gate in server.ts. V1 asks the sequencer internally, blocks if the sequencer requires fresh human approval, supports the sequencer-selected clearance preview gate, and when applyPreviewFollowOn is true creates clearance internally only through forgepilot_create_operator_local_execution_clearance. TypeScript compilation passed. Direct packet-id lint/test commands were blocked by the platform filter during this run, but the new executor file was checked for hardcoded packet IDs and contained none.
caveats: V1 intentionally supports only the approval-block and clearance preview/create segment.
Scoped enablement creation and runner start are not supported by this executor V1.
The MCP service must be restarted or actions refreshed before the new executor tool is available in chat.
The general test/lint script could not be run because the platform filtered the command during this run; TypeScript compilation passed.
boundaries: no approval artifact created by this packet
